answer.sql:
WITH tg AS (
  SELECT game_date_est, games_game_id, home_team_id AS team_id, home_team_wins AS win
  FROM enterprise_dw.TRANSFORMED.src_games
  WHERE season = 2012 AND games_game_id // 10000000 = 2 AND home_team_wins IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT game_date_est, games_game_id, visitor_team_id AS team_id, 1 - home_team_wins AS win
  FROM enterprise_dw.TRANSFORMED.src_games
  WHERE season = 2012 AND games_game_id // 10000000 = 2 AND home_team_wins IS NOT NULL
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT team_id, win, game_date_est, games_game_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY game_date_est, games_game_id)
         - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id, win ORDER BY game_date_est, games_game_id) AS grp
  FROM tg
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT team_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_length,
         MIN(game_date_est) AS streak_start, MAX(game_date_est) AS streak_end
  FROM numbered
  WHERE win = 1
  GROUP BY team_id, grp
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY streak_length DESC) AS rnk
  FROM streaks
),
names AS (
  SELECT TEAM_ID AS team_id, MAX(TEAM) AS team_name
  FROM enterprise_dw.RAW.raw_ranking
  GROUP BY TEAM_ID
)
SELECT r.team_id, n.team_name, r.streak_length, r.streak_start, r.streak_end
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN names n ON n.team_id = r.team_id
WHERE r.rnk = 1
ORDER BY r.team_id
LIMIT 501
